en_quote: Cooperation between FIUs and law enforcement results in law enforcement action.
knowledge_zh: 金融情报机构与执法机构合作可促成执法行动

en_quote: Addressing money laundering requires cooperation and information sharing both domestically and internationally.
knowledge_zh: 打击洗钱需要国内与国际合作及信息共享

en_quote: International bodies such as Eurojust and Europol have an important role in coordinating such activity.
knowledge_zh: Eurojust和Europol等国际机构在协调此类活动中发挥重要作用
